description: Fix review issues: TOCTOU race in deduct_balance, deposit ghost rows, pseudo-hash collision, TRON_API_KEY validation, minimum deposit threshold
steps: Fix deduct_balance() in db.py to use atomic UPDATE...WHERE balance >= ? and check cursor.rowcount == 1
Remove optimistic insert pattern in customer_bot.py: call record_deposit AFTER verification succeeds, remove _remove_deposit and _update_deposit_amount helpers
Fix pseudo-hash collision: include uid and os.urandom in pseudo_hash, reorder so deduct_balance is called AFTER record_payment succeeds
Add TRON_API_KEY warning back to validate_customer() in config.py
Add MIN_DEPOSIT_TRX config, check minimum deposit after verification in customer_bot.py
acceptance_criteria: deduct_balance uses atomic UPDATE with WHERE balance >= ? guard
No deposit record inserted before verification; record_deposit called only after verification succeeds
pseudo_hash includes uid and random component
deduct_balance called AFTER record_payment succeeds (not before)
MIN_DEPOSIT_TRX config exists, deposits below threshold rejected with Persian message
verification: python -m py_compile db.py && python -m py_compile customer_bot.py && python -m py_compile config.py && python -m py_compile tron.py
findings: All 5 review issues fixed: (1) deduct_balance now uses atomic UPDATE with WHERE balance >= ? guard and checks rowcount; (2) optimistic insert pattern removed - record_deposit called only after verification succeeds, _remove_deposit and _update_deposit_amount helpers deleted; (3) pseudo_hash uses f"balance_{uid}_{timestamp}_{os.urandom(4).hex()}" and deduct_balance is called after record_payment; (4) TRON_API_KEY re-added to validate_customer() as a warning; (5) MIN_DEPOSIT_TRX config added (default 1), deposits below threshold rejected with Persian message. All files pass py_compile.
